title: 018 - Case-Insensitive Search
prompt: Fix the bug so the program print found when the text contains the query regardless of case and prints exactly `found`. Keep the sample data and do not add extra output.
brokenCode:
def case_insensitive_search(score):
    return "PASS" if score > 40 else "FAIL"
solutionCode:
def case_insensitive_search(score):
    return "PASS" if score >= 40 else "FAIL"
explanation: The broken search compares different letter cases directly. Lowercasing both sides fixes the match.
